name: TD SYNNEX Corporation
summary: TD SYNNEX Corporation operates as a distributor and solutions aggregator for the information technology ecosystem in the United States, Europe, and internationally. It offers personal computing devices and peripherals, mobile phones and accessories, printers, and supplies; and data center technologies, such as hybrid cloud, security, storage, networking, servers, software, converged and hyper-converged infrastructure, and hyperscale infrastructure.
